<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_BecomingAParent"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Parent" name="Parent" processRef="Process_Parent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Leave notification"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompany" name="Leave notification"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyInformation" name="Company information"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Parent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Planning" name="Maternity leave planning started"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FetchLeaveModels" name="Fetch leave models (duration, split between parents)"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectLeaveModel" name="Select leave model"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectRelevantInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifySplit" name="Notify split"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCompany" name="Notify Company"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifyJoin" name="Notifications done"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from Company"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_LeavePeriodEnds" name="Leave period ended">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LeavePeriodEnds"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideExtension" name="Decide about extension"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extend leave?" default="Flow_NoExtension"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LeaveEnded" name="Maternity leave ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToFetch" sourceRef="Start_Planning" targetRef="Task_FetchLeaveModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FetchToSelect" sourceRef="Task_FetchLeaveModels" targetRef="Task_SelectLeaveModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToCollect" sourceRef="Task_SelectLeaveModel" targetRef="Task_CollectRelevantInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToNotifySplit" sourceRef="Task_CollectRelevantInformation" targetRef="Gateway_NotifySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSocialSecurity" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCompany" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SocialSecurityToJoin" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyToJoin" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToGather" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatherToLeaveEnds" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Event_LeavePeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveEndsToDecision" sourceRef="Event_LeavePeriodEnds" targetRef="Task_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionToGateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Extend" name="Extend leave" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="Task_SelectLeaveModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoExtension" name="Do not extend" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="End_LeaveEnded"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description names several activities that are carried out side by side, with no stated order among them, and a later step starts only after all of them are finished: Model a parallel split gateway before the group of activities, with one unconditional outgoing flow to each activity. Join the activities with a parallel join gateway, and connect one outgoing flow from that join to the later step. Do not add decision conditions to these branches, and do not chain the activities in sequence when the description does not order them.
rules.situation: the description lists several actions with no stated order, some of which may be carried out by different parties or wait for an external reply, and a later step can start only after all of them are completed

rules.instruction: When the description says a person chooses an option, decides, collects information, or prepares documents, and it names no software, application, form, or system that the person uses for that step: Model such a step as a bpmn:manualTask, because it is human work performed without an execution application. Reserve bpmn:userTask for steps the description ties to a software system, such as a form or application the person works in.
rules.situation: the description says a person chooses an option, decides, collects information, or prepares documents, and it names no software, application, form, or system that the person uses for that step

rules.instruction: When the description states that two or more activities are performed independently, by different teams or systems, and a later step can proceed only after all of them have finished: Model a parallel gateway that forks the flow before the independent activities and a parallel gateway that joins them before the first step that needs all of them, instead of a sequential chain or an exclusive gateway.
rules.situation: the description lists several actions aimed at different external parties or different actors (for example notifying one party and requesting information from another) with no stated order, and a later step can proceed only after all of them are finished

rules.instruction: When the description says an activity fetches, gathers, or notifies about information for an external party, such as a company or authority, and names the information and the party in its own words: Label the activity with the information or action the description names, using the description's own noun phrase and verb, and keep the named external party in the label instead of a generic term. Do not substitute a paraphrased or more generic label for the stated information, and do not change the action verb the description uses for that step.
rules.situation: the description says an activity fetches, gathers, or notifies about information for an external party, such as a company or authority, and names the information and the party in its own words
